## Index record

- **ID:** REM-0012
- **Title:** A close at the broker could not be booked once more than 100 fills had passed since the entry
- **Date:** 2026-10-05
- **Status:** recorded in the hash-chained remediation ledger
- **Authority:** REMEDIATION
- **What was wrong:** broker.fill_activities read one page - the account's last 100 fills - though its docstring said every fill. _learn_from_external_exits rebuilds a position closed at the broker (its resting take profit since EXP-0056/0057, or its stop) from that page. A position held while more than 100 fills happened had its entry off the page, and its close was logged external_exit_unrecoverable: the realized result never reached the bot's reports or the learner. The original account placed about 30 orders in its last two weeks, before partial fills, so a 20-session hold could cross the page.
- **Correction:** AlpacaPaperBroker.fill_activities_back_to(oldest) follows Alpaca's page_token, newest first, until a short page, a fill older than `oldest`, or 30 pages. autotrade._fills_reaching_entries uses it only when the first page was full and a vanished position's round trip is incomplete, reading to two days before the oldest such entry; any error keeps the first page and the cycle continues (event external_exit_fill_paging_failed). The one-page read is unchanged.
- **Affects:** LIVE money path - booking of closes made at the broker only. No strategy rule, parameter or order.
- **Economic rules changed:** False
- **Fingerprint before → after:** `448170c336493556…` → `448170c336493556…`
- **Historical results usable:** True
- **Reports affected:** None in the past; future closes made at the broker.
